evidence: Carries the IPC label, modifies Cap'n Proto interface definitions and libmultiprocess subtree, and exposes interfaces::Chain across the process boundary.
rationale: Exposing the Chain interface over IPC is a prerequisite for running the wallet in a separate process (#10102) and unblocks external client consumers. As stated in the description, 'Processes connected to bitcoin-node over IPC... can't currently use the Chain interface to read chain data or follow chain events,' which directly blocks process separation for bitcoin-wallet.
